user_question: Calculate average elevation inside the State College and Bellefonte borough boundaries.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate average elevation inside the State College and Bellefonte borough boundaries.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject DEM to boundary CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the DEM into the CRS used by the borough boundary polygons so zonal statistics can be computed.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the input GeoTIFF DEM to EPSG:26918. Preserve the elevation values and produce a GeoTIFF raster.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the average DEM elevation within each of the State College and Bellefonte borough boundaries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean elevation from the reprojected DEM within each polygon of the borough boundary layer. Preserve sufficient zone-identifying attributes from the input polygons so the results can be associated with State College and Bellefonte. Produce a CSV summary table.

requirements.scope: The reprojected DEM and borough boundary polygons must use compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
